documents.content:
# kratos-admin

`kratos-admin` 是一个前后端分离的管理系统仓库，包含 Go + Kratos 后端、Vue 管理后台、uni-app 应用底座、React/Taro 应用底座、版本化数据库迁移和模块脚手架。

## 已实现能力

- 账号密码、验证码、OAuth、JWT 刷新、租户和 Casbin 权限。
- 用户、角色、部门、岗位、菜单、字典、配置、任务、日志、地区、API 和迁移记录管理。
- Proto 驱动的 HTTP、gRPC、OpenAPI、Agent Tool、MCP Tool 和 TypeScript RPC 生成。
- AI 会话、流式消息、附件、工具调用、重试、再生成和分支会话。
- 管理端代码生成配置、预览、生成进度和还原。
- 运行日志浏览：实时控制台 SSE、历史日志查询、级别和关键字筛选及历史原文件下载。
- 构建期收集当前项目、宿主项目和外部模块的 README/docs，并在管理端统一查看。
- 可挂载的 Go Core 模块；后端实现 `module.Module`，通过 `Resources` 提供静态资源，并由启动入口交给 Core 统一注册协议服务。
- 管理端、uni-app、Taro 和后端错误目录的语言集合由语言包自动发现；动态菜单、字典和代码生成同步支持所有已注册语言。

仓库不包含商城、订单、支付或推荐等业务模块。

## 目录

| 目录 | 说明 | 文档 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` | Kratos 服务、Proto、GORM、迁移和 Core 宿主组合。 | [backend/README.md](backend/README.md) |
| `frontend/admin` | 管理端 workspace，包含默认宿主、core、System 和 CLI。 | [frontend/admin/README.md](frontend/admin/README.md) |
| `frontend/uni-app` | uni-app workspace，包含默认宿主、core、system 和 CLI。 | [frontend/uni-app/README.md](frontend/uni-app/README.md) |
| `frontend/taro-app` | React/Taro workspace，包含默认宿主、core、UI、system 和 CLI。 | [frontend/taro-app/README.md](frontend/taro-app/README.md) |
| `docs` | 当前架构、操作流程和专题说明。 | [docs/README.md](docs/README.md) |

## 环境

- Go `1.26.3`。
- Node.js `^20.19.0` 或 `>=22.12.0`。
- pnpm 版本以各 workspace 的 `packageManager` 为准：管理端 `10.33.4`，uni-app 与 Taro 应用端 `10.13.1`。
- MySQL 和 Redis；默认连接见 `backend/configs/data.yaml`。
- Docker 部署需要可用的 Docker CLI 与 Docker daemon。
- Buf、protoc 插件、Wire 和 gorm-gen 只在重新生成代码时需要，可通过 `make -C backend init` 安装。

直接执行 `make` 或 `make help` 查看仓库级命令；Backend 和 Frontend 的完整目标分别使用 `make -C backend help`、`make -C frontend help` 查看。

## 本地启动

先创建数据库：

```sql
CREATE DATABASE kratos_admin CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
```

安装前端依赖：

```bash
make -C frontend init
```

如果依赖目录需要完全重建：

```bash
make -C frontend reinstall
```

启动后端：

```bash
make -C backend run
```

`run` 会先刷新启动所需的接口、文档和 Wire 产物；确认生成产物未变化时可使用 `make -C backend run-only` 直接启动。完整目标、执行顺序和参数见 [Backend 常用流程](backend/README.md#常用流程)。

启动管理后台、uni-app 或 Taro H5（每个命令都应在独立终端运行）：

```bash
make -C frontend run-admin
cd frontend/uni-app && pnpm dev:h5
cd ../taro-app && pnpm dev:h5
```

| 服务 | 默认地址 |
| --- | --- |
| 后端 HTTP | `http://localhost:7001` |
| 后端 gRPC | `localhost:6001` |
| 管理后台 | `http://localhost:8848` |
| uni-app H5 | `http://localhost:5004` |
| Taro H5 | `http://localhost:5002` |

uni-app 和 Taro H5 默认分别使用 `5004` 与 `5002`，可以同时启动。局域网设备访问 uni-app 时，将 `localhost` 替换为开发机局域网 IP。

默认迁移提供开发账号 `super / 112233` 和 `admin / 112233`。部署前必须修改默认密码、JWT 密钥、数据库和 Redis 凭据。

## 生成与检查

```bash
make -C backend gen
make check
make -C frontend build-all
```

`make check` 按 Backend、管理端模块边界、管理后台、uni-app、Taro 的顺序执行检查。`build-all` 构建管理后台及两个应用端的 H5 宿主；生成全部 npm 发布包使用 `make -C frontend package`，微信小程序仍分别执行各 workspace 的 `pnpm build:mp-weixin`。

后端默认通过 `make -C backend build` 构建 `linux/amd64` 二进制，通过 `make -C backend package` 生成包含 `bin/server` 和 `configs` 的发布压缩包；目标平台可使用 `GOOS`、`GOARCH` 覆盖。

Docker 镜像通过现有 Backend 命令构建：

```bash
make -C backend docker-build IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest
make -C backend docker-run IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest
make -C backend docker-stop IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest
```

构建命令先检查 Docker，再构建管理后台、uni-app H5、Taro H5 和 Linux 后端程序。运行命令发布宿主机 `7001/6001` 端口，将 `backend/data` 映射到 `/app/data`，并首次初始化可在宿主机修改的 `backend/runtime/configs` 后映射到 `/app/configs`。三端静态站点随镜像发布，启动时合并到 `/app/data`，已有上传文件不会被清空。完整构建参数和运行示例见 [Backend 构建与打包](backend/README.md#构建与打包)。

`I18N_LOCALES` 使用逗号分隔的 BCP 47 语言代码列表（默认 `en-US,zh-TW,ja-JP`），统一控制项目文档和 OpenAPI 的目标语言。`make i18n-docs` 由仓库内 `scripts/project_docs.py` 按三段路径范围收集 README 与 docs Markdown，再生成 `docs.json` 和 `docs.<locale>.json`；对应的 `README.en-US.md`、`guide.ja-JP.md` 等语言源文件存在时直接使用，否则才执行机器翻译。语言目录只本地化文档正文和显示文件名，`README.md` 显示名、目录名称及稳定路径保持不变。如需使用外部实现，可通过 `PROJECT_DOCS_SCRIPT` 覆盖脚本路径。`make i18n-openapi` 生成 OpenAPI 多语言 YAML。离线生成使用 `I18N_OFFLINE=1 make i18n`。

`backend/api/gen`、`backend/internal/data/gen`、`backend/internal/docs/assets/docs*.json`、`backend/internal/docs/docs.go`、各前端包的 `src/rpc`、OpenAPI 及 `wire_gen.go` 都是生成产物，不得手工修改。所有前端 RPC 的 Buf 配置统一位于 `backend/api`，管理端通过 `make -C backend ts-admin` 生成，应用端分别通过 `make -C backend ts-uni-app` 和 `make -C backend ts-taro-app` 生成；需要一次生成三端时执行 `make -C backend ts`。

`make -C backend gen` 会同时生成 `backend/internal/module` 的公共入口内部 Wire 产物和 `backend/internal/cmd/server` 的独立启动 Wire 产物；单独刷新前者使用 `make -C backend public-wire`，单独刷新自定义组合根可通过 `WIRE_DIR` 指定包含 `wire.go` 的目录。

外部 Go 项目将 `github.com/liujitcn/kratos-admin/backend` 的具名模块、资源、定时任务、SSE 流和队列消费者贡献与自身贡献合并后，再交给 `github.com/liujitcn/kratos-core` 创建协议服务及应用生命周期；外部生成代码不会引用 `backend/internal`。

`make i18n-openapi` 会在生成 `openapi.yaml` 后同步生成 `openapi.en-US.yaml`、`openapi.zh-TW.yaml` 和 `openapi.ja-JP.yaml`。默认资源来自后端错误目录和管理端 Core 语言包；外部资源可通过 `OPENAPI_I18N_CONTENT="语言=路径"` 传入。未命中的文案默认自动翻译：英文和日语使用 Google V1，繁体中文使用 OpenCC；设置 `I18N_AUTO_LOCALIZE=0` 可关闭自动翻译。无网络环境使用 `I18N_OFFLINE=1 make i18n-openapi`。

## 国际化

语言包定义系统能够渲染的语言集合，`base_language` 表只负责运行时启用状态、名称、排序和主语言配置。管理端语言偏好保存为 `kratos-admin:locale`，uni-app 和 Taro 保存为 `kratos-app:locale`；所有 HTTP、刷新令牌、fetch、SSE、uni.request 和 Taro.request 请求都会发送规范化的 `Accept-Language`。固定文案由各 workspace 的 core/System JSON 语言包维护，动态菜单和字典由后端翻译表按请求语言解析，缺少当前语言译文时回退主语言。

新增语言不需要修改 Go、TypeScript 或模块注册代码：在后端错误目录和三个 workspace 的六个前端语言包目录中增加同名 JSON，并在代码生成 `catalog.json` 中增加同名数据，然后执行 `make i18n-sync`。脚本会校验语言集合、语言键和占位符，并生成六个前端注册文件、Element Plus 和 Day.js 映射。语言名称、排序、启用状态和主语言由 `base_language` 数据库记录提供；`common.language.*` 用于编译期离线显示和生成语言迁移的初始名称。新增语言的完整文件清单和迁移流程见 [国际化语言扩展指南](docs/国际化语言扩展指南.md)。需要把语言加入新部署数据库时，再执行 `make i18n-sync I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=vX.Y.Z`，提交脚本生成的版本化 `base_language` 迁移；已有数据库的启用状态不会被迁移覆盖。

动态资源的主语言由 `base_language.is_primary` 配置。创建或更新菜单、字典、字典项和系统配置时，后端按请求 `Accept-Language` 将输入文本转换为主语言写入主表；请求语言不是主语言时，原文写入对应翻译表，其他已启用非主语言也只保存在翻译表。系统配置名称、菜单标题、字典名称和字典项标签支持在管理端点击名称打开翻译弹窗，文本/富文本配置值支持运行时翻译回退。

国际化常用命令：

```bash
make i18n-check
make i18n-sync
make i18n-docs
make i18n-openapi
make i18n
```

新增语言直接写入当前 `v0.0.1` 迁移：

```bash
I18N_LOCALE=ja-JP make i18n-locale
I18N_LOCALE=de-DE I18N_OFFLINE=1 make i18n-locale
```

在线模式使用 Google V1，离线模式使用内置术语表和 OpenCC。生成后应审核 JSON 与 SQL；已有数据库的语言启用状态不会被覆盖。运行时翻译表单仍可对动态资源执行即时翻译，已有非空译文不会覆盖。

## 发布

统一发布会更新并发布 10 个 npm 包：

- `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-system`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-cli`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-core`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-system`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-cli`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-core`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-ui`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-system`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-cli`

```bash
make tag VERSION=0.0.18
```

`make tag` 会先执行 `make i18n-docs` 刷新内嵌项目文档，再由发布脚本将文档和版本更新一起提交。脚本要求当前分支为远程默认分支且与 `origin` 同步，执行后端测试和前端打包，然后推送 `vX.Y.Z`、`backend/vX.Y.Z`、`npm/vX.Y.Z`。`npm/vX.Y.Z` 触发 `.github/workflows/publish-npm.yml`，通过 npm Trusted Publishing 发布以上 10 个包；三个默认宿主均为私有包，不参与发布。本机需要可用的 `git`、`gh` 和 GitHub 登录态。

只做本地 npm 发布时：

```bash
pnpm login
make -C frontend publish
```

发布脚本会跳过 registry 中已存在的同版本包，支持失败后重试。私有 registry 可通过 `NPM_REGISTRY`、`NPM_ACCESS` 和 `NPM_TAG` 覆盖。

## 文档

| 主题 | 文档 |
| --- | --- |
| 总体架构 | [docs/系统总体设计.md](docs/系统总体设计.md) |
| 新能力接入 | [docs/服务接入指南.md](docs/服务接入指南.md) |
| 数据库迁移 | [docs/数据库与初始化数据设计.md](docs/数据库与初始化数据设计.md) |
| 参数校验 | [docs/接口参数校验设计.md](docs/接口参数校验设计.md) |
| 登录和密码 | [docs/登录与密码加密流程.md](docs/登录与密码加密流程.md) |
| AI 助手 | [docs/AI助手设计.md](docs/AI助手设计.md) |
| 管理端组件 | [docs/前端组件清单.md](docs/前端组件清单.md) |
| 国际化设计 | [docs/国际化最终方案.md](docs/国际化最终方案.md) |
| 新增语言 | [docs/国际化语言扩展指南.md](docs/国际化语言扩展指南.md) |

documents.content:
# backend

`backend` 保留 API 契约、Go 生成接口、Service 实现、Biz 业务层，以及任务调度、HTTP/gRPC/MCP/AI 注册和必要的数据访问闭包；进程入口位于 `internal/cmd/server`。根包通过 `ProviderSet`、`NewModuleResources`、`NewModules`、`NewTasks`、`NewStreams` 和 `NewQueueConsumers` 提供可被外部 Core 宿主复用的公共边界，`internal/module` 仅承载内部实现。AI Runtime 实现在 `internal/biz`，对外复用入口为 `pkg/agent`。

## 目录

```text
backend
├── internal/cmd/server             # Admin 独立启动入口与 Wire 组合根
├── api
│   ├── proto                         # Proto 契约
│   └── gen/go                        # Buf 生成的 Go 接口、HTTP、gRPC 和工具代码
├── internal/biz                      # 业务 Case、DTO、代码生成和辅助领域代码
├── bootstrap.go                      # 对外 ProviderSet 和模块/任务/SSE/队列/资源入口
├── internal/module                   # Admin 到 kratos-core 的内部模块适配和资源实现
│   ├── module.go                     # Core Module 协议注册
│   ├── resources.go                  # module.Module 静态资源
│   ├── init.go                        # Admin 模块 ProviderSet
│   └── wire.go / wire_gen.go          # 公共入口使用的内部依赖装配
├── pkg/agent                         # 对外复用的 AI Runtime、模型和工具 API
├── internal/task                     # 异步任务与定时任务执行器
├── internal/server                   # 服务中间件和 API 模块注册适配
├── internal/task                     # 异步业务任务
├── internal/data/gen                 # GORM 生成的模型、查询和仓储
├── internal/service                  # Proto Service 实现
├── internal/const                    # 业务常量
├── internal/i18n/assets              # 业务语言资源
└── migration                         # 代码生成业务使用的迁移资源
```

## 常用流程

进入 `backend` 目录后，先通过帮助查看全部目标、参数默认值和覆盖示例：

```bash
make help
```

首次开发安装 Buf、protoc、Wire、gorm-gen、goimports 和检查工具：

```bash
make init
```

日常启动使用：

```bash
make run
```

`make run` 会按“项目文档 -> protobuf Go -> OpenAPI -> 独立入口 Wire -> 启动服务”的顺序刷新必要产物。确认生成产物没有变化时，可跳过生成直接启动：

```bash
make run-only
```

默认配置目录为 `./configs`，可以覆盖配置目录或追加启动参数：

```bash
make run-only CONF=/path/to/configs
make run-only RUN_ARGS='--help'
```

独立入口注入 `kratoscore.ProviderSet` 与内部模块 ProviderSet；Core 负责统一创建和管理 HTTP、gRPC、MCP、SSE、队列与定时任务运行时。

## 修改后执行

| 修改场景 | 命令 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Proto 契约 | `make api openapi ts` | 生成 Go、OpenAPI 和三个前端的 TypeScript RPC。只影响一个前端时可改用 `ts-admin`、`ts-uni-app` 或 `ts-taro-app`。 |
| 数据库表结构 | `make gorm-gen` | 先更新开发库，再按 `GORM_GEN_CONFIG`、`GORM_GEN_DATABASE` 和 `GORM_TABLE` 生成。 |
| ProviderSet 或构造参数 | `make public-wire wire` | 分别刷新公共入口内部装配和独立服务入口。 |
| README 或 docs | `make project-docs` | 收集 Markdown，并生成各语言文档目录。 |
| 语言包或国际化资源 | `make i18n` | 依次同步语言包、项目文档和 OpenAPI 多语言产物。 |
| 多类生成源同时变化 | `make gen` | 依次执行 GORM、接口、前端、文档、Wire 和格式化；需要可访问开发数据库。 |

所有生成产物都必须通过上述命令刷新，不能手工修改。

## 检查

提交前执行完整 Backend 检查：

```bash
make check
```

`make check` 依次运行 `make lint`、`make test` 和 `make i18n-check`，不会自动格式化代码。需要格式化时先执行：

```bash
make fmt
```

也可以单独运行某一项：

```bash
make lint
make test
make i18n-check
```

## 构建与打包

默认构建 `linux/amd64`、`CGO_ENABLED=0` 的可执行文件：

```bash
make build
```

产物为 `bin/server`。发布压缩包同时包含可执行文件和 `configs` 目录：

```bash
make package
```

默认输出 `dist/backend-linux-amd64.tar.gz`。其他平台可以覆盖参数：

```bash
make package GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64
make build GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 BINARY=bin/server-darwin-arm64
```

解压发布包后，可通过 `./bin/server --conf ./configs` 启动。打包前应检查 `configs` 内的数据库、Redis、JWT 和其他部署配置，不要直接发布本地凭据。

仓库内置的 `docker-build` 会先验证 Docker CLI 和 Docker daemon，然后依次构建管理后台、uni-app H5、Taro H5、Linux 后端程序和最终镜像：

```bash
make docker-build \
  IMAGE=kratos-admin \
  TAG=v1.0.0
```

默认生成 `linux/amd64` 镜像。构建 ARM64 镜像时同时指定 Go 和 Docker 平台：

```bash
make docker-build GOARCH=arm64 DOCKER_PLATFORM=linux/arm64
```

镜像把三端静态站点保存在只读种子目录，容器启动时将其合并到 `/app/data`。本地 OSS 上传的图片、附件及其他运行期文件也位于 `/app/data`，因此部署时应将整个目录绑定到宿主机；启动脚本只覆盖镜像提供的站点文件，不会清空已有上传目录。

本地构建完成后使用 `docker-run` 启动容器：

```bash
make docker-run IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=v1.0.0
```

该命令默认使用桥接网络并发布宿主机 `7001`、`6001` 端口。首次运行会把 `configs/*.yaml` 初始化到宿主机 `runtime/configs`，将 MySQL、Redis、Consul 等容器主动连接的本机地址改为 `host.docker.internal`，再只读映射到 `/app/configs`；OAuth 浏览器回调地址保持不变。宿主机修改 `runtime/configs` 中的 YAML 后重启容器即可生效，不需要重建镜像。

宿主机 `data` 映射到 `/app/data`。数据、配置、网络和发布端口可以通过 `DOCKER_DATA_DIR`、`DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR`、`DOCKER_NETWORK`、`DOCKER_HTTP_PORT`、`DOCKER_GRPC_PORT` 覆盖。删除 `runtime/configs` 后再次执行 `make docker-run` 可以按当前 `configs` 重新初始化运行配置。

停止本地服务但保留容器和宿主机数据：

```bash
make docker-stop IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=v1.0.0
```

之后再次执行 `make docker-run` 会自动清理已停止的同名容器并重新创建。

镜像本身不会包含 `configs/*_local.yaml`、历史上传文件、代码生成恢复文件或运行日志。`docker-run` 挂载宿主机配置目录后，本地配置文件只在运行期对容器可见。

## 常用参数

| 参数 | 默认值 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONF` | `./configs` | 服务运行配置目录。 |
| `RUN_ARGS` | 空 | 追加到服务命令后的参数。 |
| `CGO_ENABLED` | `0` | Go 构建时是否启用 CGO。 |
| `GOOS` / `GOARCH` | `linux` / `amd64` | 构建目标平台。 |
| `BINARY` | `bin/server` | 可执行文件输出路径。 |
| `ARCHIVE` | `dist/backend-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz` | 发布压缩包输出路径。 |
| `DOCKER` | `docker` | Docker 命令路径或名称。 |
| `DOCKERFILE` | `Dockerfile` | Dockerfile 路径。 |
| `DOCKER_PLATFORM` | `linux/<GOARCH>` | 镜像目标平台。 |
| `IMAGE` / `TAG` | `backend` / `latest` | Docker 镜像名称和标签。 |
| `CONTAINER_NAME` | `kratos-admin` | 本地运行的容器名称。 |
| `DOCKER_NETWORK` | `bridge` | 容器网络。 |
| `DOCKER_HTTP_PORT` | `7001` | 映射到容器 `7001` 的宿主机 HTTP 端口。 |
| `DOCKER_GRPC_PORT` | `6001` | 映射到容器 `6001` 的宿主机 gRPC 端口。 |
| `DOCKER_DATA_DIR` | `backend/data` | 映射到 `/app/data` 的宿主机目录。 |
| `DOCKER_CONFIG_SOURCE_DIR` | `backend/configs` | 首次初始化 Docker 运行配置的源目录。 |
| `DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR` | `backend/runtime/configs` | 只读映射到 `/app/configs` 的宿主机运行配置目录。 |
| `DOCKER_RUN_ARGS` | 空 | 传给 `docker run` 的其他参数。 |
| `PUBLIC_WIRE_DIR` | `internal/module` | 公共入口使用的内部 `wire.go` 所在目录。 |
| `WIRE_DIR` | `internal/cmd/server` | 独立入口 `wire.go` 所在目录。 |
| `GORM_GEN_CONFIG` | `configs/data_local.yaml` | GORM 生成使用的数据源配置。 |
| `GORM_GEN_DATABASE` | 空 | 可选数据库名，默认读取配置文件。 |
| `GORM_TABLE` | 内置表清单 | 逗号分隔的 GORM 生成表。 |
| `I18N_LOCALES` | `en-US,zh-TW,ja-JP` | 文档和 OpenAPI 的目标语言。 |
| `I18N_OFFLINE` | `0` | 设为 `1` 时禁用在线翻译。 |
| `PROJECT_DOCS_SCRIPT` | `../scripts/project_docs.py` | 项目文档收集与本地化脚本。 |

## 外部宿主复用

外部 Go 项目复用 Backend 时，在自己的 Wire 组合根中加入 `kratoscore.ProviderSet`、`backend.ProviderSet` 和宿主的合并 ProviderSet：

```go
func NewApp(ctx *bootstrap.Context) (*kratos.App, func(), error) {
	panic(wire.Build(
		kratoscore.ProviderSet,
		backend.ProviderSet,
		mergeProviderSet,
	))
}
```

根包通过 `AdminResources`、`AdminModules`、`AdminTasks`、`AdminStreams` 和 `AdminConsumers` 输出具名贡献，宿主的合并 ProviderSet 将它们与其他业务模块的贡献显式追加为 Core 最终集合。公开构造器只使用 Core 公共类型，外部生成的 `wire_gen.go` 不会依赖 `backend/internal`。

`backend.NewModules` 初始化的是宿主进程级运行日志采集器；外部项目按上述方式接入 Backend 后，其自身以及其他已注册模块写入 stdout/stderr 的日志也会进入运行日志实时控制台，历史日志文件则按宿主的日志配置读取。

外部模块接入 AI 时使用 `pkg/agent.NewRuntime` 创建运行时，通过 `RuntimeConfig.AdminTools/AppTools` 或 `Runtime.RegisterTool` 注册 Eino `InvokableTool`；简单结构化工具优先使用 `pkg/agent.InferTool` 自动生成参数 schema。评论审核、内容提取等固定流程可以组合 `NewChatClient`、`NewStructuredRunner`、`SchemaFor` 和多模态 Part 构造函数，不需要引用 `internal` 包。需要权限控制时实现 `ToolAccessChecker`，不接入权限系统则保持 `Checker` 为 `nil`。

documents.name: AI assistant design.md
documents.content:
# AI assistant

AI assistant is a conversational capability shared by the management side, uni-app and Taro application side. The three portals use the same set of `base.v1` interfaces and data tables, but filter the available tools and shortcut portals by terminal.

## Implemented capabilities

- Session creation, listing, renaming, deleting and persisting branches.
- Message list, text and attachment sending, editing last message, deletion, failed retry and regeneration.
- `delta`, `finish`, `error` Direct streaming responses to three types of SSE events.
- Markdown, model source, Token, first Token time consumption, total time consumption and tool call record.
- Filters generated Agent Tools by terminal, interface switch, and user permissions.
- Fixed process quick entry and structured actions; old message actions will be judged as expired by the server.
- Responses server tool record; returns an explicit unavailable error when the current model is not enabled.

## Contract and data

| Capabilities | Proto | HTTP Prefix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Quick entry | `backend/api/proto/base/v1/ai_tool.proto` | `/api/v1/base/ai/shortcut` |
| Session | `ai_session.proto` | `/api/v1/base/ai/session` |
| Messages | `ai_message.proto` | `/api/v1/base/ai/session/{session_id}/message` |

data is persisted to `ai_session` and `ai_message`. A round of messages saves input, output, attachments, tools, tokens, time consumption, status and optional structured process content. The action must carry `source_message_id`, `action_id` and `flow_version` of the current latest success message.

The HTTP handler that sends the message returns `text/event-stream` directly, without using the generic `/events/{stream}` subscription. At the end of the stream the `finish` event returns the final message and updated session.

## Backend link

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  API["AiMessageService"] --> Case["AiMessageCase"]
  Case --> Runtime["biz/base/ai.Runtime"]
  Runtime --> ADK["internal/agent/adk"]
  ADK --> Model["Eino Agentic Model"]
  ADK --> Tools["按终端和权限筛选的工具"]
  Case --> DB[("ai_session / ai_message")]
```

`internal/biz/base/ai` is responsible for business protocols, historical messages, attachments, terminal policies, fixed processes and result persistence; `internal/agent` isolates Eino's model, messages, ADK, Middleware, Callback, Tool, Structured and Workflow details.

Agent Tool comes from generated code, `agent_status` controls whether it can be used by AI; `mcp_status` independently controls whether it is exposed as MCP Tool. The two are not the same switch.

## Management end

The management terminal is located at `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/ai/chat`:

| Documentation | Responsibilities |
| --- | --- |
| `index.vue` | General orchestration of conversations, messages, sends and actions. |
| `components/SessionPanel.vue` | Session search, creation, switching, renaming and deletion. |
| `components/ChatPanel.vue` | Message area, empty state, shortcut entry and message operation. |
| `components/XSender.vue` | Text, attachments, and delivery status. |
| `components/AiMarkdown.vue` | Markdown and code content. |
| `stream.ts`, `message.ts` | SSE parsing and message status normalization. |

The System module also registers the AI ​​icon as a top tool. The Structured Process Block component is not a built-in fixed implementation; other business modules may provide `flowBlocks` extensions via `ADMIN_AI_EXTENSION`.

## Application side

uni-app is located at `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai` and Taro is located at `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai`. Both ends provide session drawers, welcome shortcuts, input and attachments, message flows, and multi-end SSE parsing. The pages belong to the `pagesMember` subpackage and use the same `base.v1` RPC and API encapsulation. H5 uses Fetch SSE; WeChat applets use the chunked request capabilities of their respective platforms.

## Configuration and verification

model configuration is located at `backend/configs/ai.yaml` and `ai_local.yaml`. The service can still be started when no model configuration is provided, but the AI ​​runtime is turned off.

executes back-end generation and testing after modifying the protocol or runtime; modifies the management side to execute `pnpm lint:oxlint`, `pnpm type:check`; modifies uni-app or Taro to execute `pnpm lint`, `pnpm tsc` of the corresponding workspace, involving the module protocol or runner Then execute `pnpm test`, `pnpm check:exports`. The front-end checks at least empty session, historical session, sending, failed, attachment and expired process action status.

| New languages | [International Language Extension Guide](国际化语言扩展指南.md) | Add language packs, generated products and database migration |

## Backend details

The documents in the backend directory are for backend development, and the rules are more specific:

- [New business process](../backend/docs/new-feature.md): the shortest closed loop of back-end capabilities.
- [Proto and HTTP Contract](../backend/docs/api.md): Protocol, path, generation and permissions synchronization.
- [Error Handling](../backend/docs/errors.md): Error classification, metadata, and hierarchical responsibilities.

## Document maintenance

- The document only describes the currently existing capabilities of the warehouse; planned capabilities must be clearly marked as "unimplemented" and cannot be written as the current status.
- Command, path, package name and interface are subject to code, Makefile, Proto and package `exports`.
- After modifying the README, `docs` or backend details, execute `make i18n-docs` to update the embedded project documentation.
- `I18N_LOCALES` uses a comma-separated list of BCP 47 language codes to control the target language of OpenAPI and project Markdown documents at the same time; `make i18n-docs` is collected from the warehouse `scripts/project_docs.py` first collects default and existing language Markdown, and then generates `docs.json` and `docs.<locale>.json` without the `locale` field. The language directory only localizes the document text and non-README display file names, and the directory name and stable path remain unchanged; external scripts can also be specified through `PROJECT_DOCS_SCRIPT`. `make i18n-openapi` Generates OpenAPI multilingual YAML. `I18N_OFFLINE=1` can be set if there is no network environment.
- The generated `backend/internal/docs/assets/docs*.json` and `backend/internal/docs/docs.go` can only be updated via `make i18n-docs`.

documents.name: Front-end component list.md
documents.content:
# Front-end component list

This article only records the components and their boundaries that exist in the current code and can be used directly. The management component implementation is located in `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/components`; the base components, UI packages and page private components of uni-app and Taro belong to their respective workspaces.

## Management-side public components

| Scenario | Component | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Paged lists, searches, column settings, bulk operations | `ProTable` | Configure lists using `columns`, `headerActions`, and `requestApi`. |
| Add or edit pop-up window | `FormDialog` | Combining `ProDialog` and `ProForm`, the page is responsible for verification, submission and refresh. |
| Details, preview, or non-form popup | `ProDialog` | Content organized by default or named slots. |
| Configuration form | `ProForm` | Fields are described by `ProFormField[]` and support existing controls such as input, selection, dictionary, upload, and rich text. |
| Dictionary selection and display | `Dict`, `DictLabel` | Registered as a global component by the core startup process. |
| Image upload | `UploadImg` | Core's public upload component; multi-image and file upload are currently only for core internal use. |
| Tree filter | `TreeFilter` | Support static data or request loading, single selection and multi-selection. |
| Icon selection | `SelectIcon` | Select the Element Plus icon name. |
| Markdown read-only preview | `MarkdownPreview` | Encapsulation `md-editor-v3`, unified security cleaning, code highlighting, light and dark themes and compact code block style. |
| Rich text | `WangEditor` | Encapsulate wangEditor and reuse the file upload service. |
| Password strength | `PasswordStrength` | Login, user and personal center password form usage. |

`CronExpression`, `ECharts`, `Grid`, `ImportExcel`, `SelectFilter`, `SwitchDark` and other components do exist but have not been passed through npm `exports` is open and should only be used within core. Whether it can be referenced across packages is subject to `frontend/admin/packages/core/package.json#exports`, and the source code directory cannot be regarded as a public interface.

## Public import entry

The business module uses the core package to expose the entry and does not reference `packages/core/src`:

```ts
import ProTable from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProTable";
import FormDialog from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dialog/FormDialog.vue";
import MarkdownPreview from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/MarkdownPreview/index.vue";
import type {
  ColumnProps,
  HeaderActionProps,
  ProTableInstance
} from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProTable/interface";
import type {
  ProFormField,
  ProFormInstance
} from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProForm/interface";
```

The currently exposed Vue component entries are as follows:

| Components | npm entry |
| --- | --- |
| `FormDialog` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dialog/FormDialog.vue` |
| `ProDialog` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dialog/ProDialog.vue` |
| `DictLabel` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dict/DictLabel.vue` |
| `MarkdownPreview` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/MarkdownPreview/index.vue` |
| `PasswordStrength` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/PasswordStrength/index.vue` |
| `ProForm` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProForm/index.vue` |
| `ProTable` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProTable` |
| `SelectIcon` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/SelectIcon/index.vue` |
| `TreeFilter` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/TreeFilter/index.vue` |
| `UploadImg` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Upload/Img.vue` |
| `WangEditor` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/WangEditor/index.vue` |

`bootstrapAdminApp` also globally registers the Element Plus icon as well as `Dict`, `DictLabel`, `SvgIcon`. Global registration facilitates direct use of templates and does not mean that the corresponding source code path has become a public entrance to npm.

## Lists and forms

### ProTable

`ProTable` is defined in `packages/core/src/components/ProTable/interface/index.ts`. Common configurations include:

- `columns`: columns, search terms, dictionaries, status and row operations.
- `requestApi`: paging request, return `{ data: { list, total } }`.
- `headerActions`: Header operations such as new addition and batch deletion.
- `cellType`: Existing `image`, `status`, `actions`, `money` cells.
- `dictCode`: Use system dictionary display or search.

page request uses core's table tool to convert paging parameters:

```ts
import { buildPageRequest } from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/table";

async function requestTable(params: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const response = await service.PageResource(buildPageRequest(params));
  return {
    data: {
      list: response.resources ?? [],
      total: response.total
    }
  };
}
```

table instance provides the ability to re-request, search, reset, clear selection, and read the current selection and paging status. The specific type is subject to `ProTableInstance`.

### ProForm and FormDialog

`ProFormField` currently supports input boxes, numbers, segmented selections, check boxes, switches, drop-downs, radio selections, multi-selections, dictionaries, tree selections, dates, Cron, shuttle boxes, image and file uploads, rich text, dynamic lists, key-value lists and custom slots.

A typical pop-up window only needs to expose components and field types:

```vue
<FormDialog
  ref="dialogRef"
  v-model="dialogVisible"
  :model="formModel"
  :fields="formFields"
  :rules="rules"
  @confirm="handleSubmit"
  @closed="resetForm"
/>
```

`FormDialog` is only responsible for interaction and verification entry, and does not automatically call the business interface. The page executes `validate()` in the confirmation event, submits the service, closes the pop-up window and refreshes the form. After closing, the model and verification status are explicitly reset.

## Markdown Preview

`MarkdownPreview` is used for read-only content such as project documentation, database migration instructions, and AI replies. The component uniformly injects local Highlight.js in the core, uses DOMPurify to clean rendering results, generates anchor points compatible with Chinese and repeated titles, and turns off Mermaid, KaTeX, ECharts, image enlargement, code folding and code line numbers.

```vue
<MarkdownPreview
  :model-value="content"
  :is-dark="globalStore.isDark"
  max-code-height="360px"
/>
```

`modelValue` is the original Markdown text, `isDark` follows the host theme, and `maxCodeHeight` only limits the maximum height of long code blocks. Single-line and double-line code blocks are always rendered at the actual content height. Business modules must no longer rely directly on the underlying `md-editor-v3` or maintain another set of Markdown themes.

## Internal components

The following components are existing implementations but are not listed in the public npm entry:

| Table of Contents | Capabilities |
| --- | --- |
| `components/Card` | Data overview card. |
| `components/CronExpression` | Six-section Cron editor. |
| `components/ECharts` | Bar, Line, Pie and other chart containers. |
| `components/ErrorMessage` | 403, 404, 500 and other error status display. |
| `components/Grid`, `SearchForm` | Responsive layout for the ProTable search area. |
| `components/ImportExcel` | Excel file import pop-up window. |
| `components/Loading` | Page and full screen loading status. |
| `components/SelectFilter` | Multiple sets of filter conditions. |
| `components/SwitchDark` | Switch between light and dark themes. |
| `components/Upload` | Upload single image, multiple images, single file, and multiple files. |

When the business module requires one of the capabilities, first confirm whether there is a public entrance. If there is indeed a need for cross-module reuse, add a clear single-component entry in `package.json#exports` of the core, and synchronize construction and type checking; do not add `components/*` wildcard export.

## Layout and page components

Four management-side layouts are located in `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/layouts`: `LayoutVertical`, `LayoutClassic`, `LayoutTransverse`, `LayoutColumns`. They are selected by core routing and global settings and are not used as business page components.

The page private components of the System module are located in `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/**/components`, such as the user page department tree, personal center form and code generation preview components. `src/components/Ai.vue` is the AI ​​entry System registered to the top toolbar. None of these components currently have npm public exports.

## Application component

uni-app core provides two base components `BootstrapStatus` and `KratosTabBar`. The public entrance is subject to `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-core/components/*.vue`; Taro core provides the corresponding `BootstrapStatus`, `KratosPageFrame` and `KratosTabBar`, and exposed through `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-core/components/*`. Taro's `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-ui` is also responsible for NutUI theme and icon entry, but does not host business pages.

The following components are private components of the AI ​​page in the two application-side system modules:

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/Composer.vue` | uni-app message input, attachment and send operations. |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/SessionDrawer.vue` | uni-app session list and switching. |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/WelcomePanel.vue` | uni-app AI page welcome area and quick entry. |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/Composer.tsx` | Taro message entry, attachment and send operations. |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/SessionDrawer.tsx` | Taro session list and switching. |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/WelcomePanel.tsx` | Taro AI page welcome area and quick entry. |

They only serve their respective `pagesMember/ai` pages and are not part of the public component interface of the application base. After at least two pages are truly reused without business semantics, consider upgrading them to the public component directory of the corresponding workspace.

## Maintenance basis

- Management side public export: `frontend/admin/packages/core/package.json#exports`
- Management component source code: `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/components`
- System page and private components: `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src`
- uni-app base component: `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/components`
- Taro base assembly: `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/components`
- Taro UI theme and icon: `frontend/taro-app/packages/ui/src`
- Application page private component: `packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components` of two workspaces

Component properties and instance methods are subject to the Vue/TypeScript type definitions in the same directory; this article does not copy the complete props to avoid retaining the invalidity of the document after adjustment.

documents.name: 国际化最终方案.md
documents.content:
# 国际化设计

本文描述仓库当前已经实现的国际化边界、运行时行为和数据职责。新增语言的具体操作以[国际化语言扩展指南](国际化语言扩展指南.md)为准。

## 当前结论

| 内容 | 当前实现 |
| --- | --- |
| 固定语言包 | `zh-CN`、`zh-TW`、`en-US`、`ja-JP` |
| 编译期默认语言 | `zh-CN` |
| 动态资源主语言 | 由 `base_language.is_primary` 决定 |
| 固定文案 | 三个前端 workspace 的 core/System JSON 语言包 |
| 后端错误 | `backend/internal/i18n/assets` 的结构化 JSON 目录 |
| 运行时语言选项 | `base_language` 接口返回的已启用语言 |
| 动态资源 | 菜单、字典、字典项和系统配置名称/值翻译表 |
| 机器翻译 | 可按需生成并保存空缺译文；已有非空译文不会覆盖 |

国际化不是把语言名称或翻译常量全部放进数据库。数据库负责部署配置，语言包负责编译期白名单和固定文案；新增语言必须同时更新两层。

## 运行时链路

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Files["语言包 JSON"] --> Sync["scripts/sync_locales.py"]
  Sync --> UI["固定 UI 与错误目录"]
  DB["base_language"] --> Options["运行时语言选项"]
  Request["Accept-Language"] --> Locale["locale 规范化"]
  Locale --> UI
  Locale --> Dynamic["动态菜单/字典/配置解析"]
  Dynamic --> Tables[("翻译表")]
```

### 编译期语言集合

`scripts/sync_locales.py` 扫描以下七个语言包目录，并额外校验代码生成器的 `catalog.json`：

```text
backend/internal/i18n/assets
frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales
frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales
frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales
backend/internal/biz/system/admin/codegen/locales/catalog.json
```

七个语言包目录的文件集合、固定 key 和占位符必须一致；`catalog.json` 还必须包含相同语言代码和固定字段。脚本生成六个前端 `generated.ts`，并校验管理端 Day.js 和 Element Plus 的 locale 映射。Core 的 `resource/i18n` 接收宿主语言资源，Core 内部负责目录加载和错误本地化，不嵌入项目词条。生成文件不能手工修改。

### 运行期语言配置

`base_language` 保存：

- `language_code`：规范的 BCP 47 语言代码；
- `language_name`、`native_name`：管理端和登录页展示名称；
- `status`、`sort`：是否可选及展示顺序；
- `is_primary`：动态菜单、字典和系统配置的主语言。

前端启动时先使用编译期包建立回退语言列表，再请求公共语言接口；数据库接口成功时以已启用语言和排序为准，失败时回退编译期语言列表。部署配置应只启用已经随包发布的语言，数据库记录本身不会生成缺失的语言包。

### 请求和回退

管理端 Axios、刷新令牌、fetch、SSE 和 Swagger 请求，以及 uni-app/Taro 的请求、上传和 SSE，统一发送规范化的 `Accept-Language`。后端按白名单匹配区域，未知值回退 `zh-CN`。

回退顺序如下：

```text
固定 UI：当前语言 -> zh-CN -> 安全默认文案
菜单/字典/配置：当前语言非空翻译 -> 主表主语言字段 -> 稳定 code/path
错误：当前语言 message_key -> zh-CN message_key -> 原始安全消息 -> INTERNAL_ERROR
```

运行时不展示裸 key、未保存的机器翻译结果、数据库错误、SQL 或第三方 provider 响应。

## 固定文案和错误目录

每个前端模块维护自己的 JSON 语言包，模块注册时校验语言集合、key、命名空间和占位符。core 维护通用能力，System 维护系统管理、个人中心和 AI 文案；模块不得直接修改另一个模块的语言包。

后端错误目录由 `go-i18n` 加载。Proto `buf.validate` 的 `id/message` 和 Go 中显式的 `WithMessageKey` 必须在 `zh-CN.json` 定义，其他语言保持相同 key 和占位符。检查命令为：

```bash
make i18n-check
```

错误对外保持现有 `code/reason`，只在 metadata 中补充稳定的 `message_key/message_args`，由响应边界按请求语言渲染 `message`。

## 前后端 Key 命名规范

前后端使用同一套分层思想，但保留各自代码生态的命名来源：前端固定文案从组件名生成业务路径，后端错误从 Proto package 和 Service 生成业务路径。Key 是稳定的技术标识，不放中文，不根据翻译结果命名。

### 前端固定文案

前端固定文案使用以下格式：

```text
<模块>.<组件业务路径>.<文案类型>.<名称>
```

组件业务路径来自 `defineOptions.name`，将 PascalCase 名称拆成小写点号路径：

```text
BaseDict      -> base.dict
BaseDictItem  -> base.dict.item
CodeGenTable  -> code.gen.table
BaseTenant    -> base.tenant
```

示例：

```text
system.base.dict.title.create
system.base.dict.field.created_at
system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
system.base.dict.message.create_success
system.code.gen.table.field.page_type
```

文案类型使用固定集合：`title`、`field`、`section`、`action`、`placeholder`、`validation`、`dialog`、`message`、`error`、`status`、`value`、`tooltip`、`empty`。名称和字段统一使用 `snake_case`，例如 `confirm_status`、`created_at`、`create_success`。

真正跨业务复用的文案使用 `common.*`，不重复加业务路径：

```text
common.action.create
common.field.created_at
common.validation.required_input
```

前端语言包的逻辑 key 使用上述点号路径。当前运行时和校验代码仍按扁平 key 读取；若将 JSON 改为嵌套对象，必须同步修改同步脚本、模块注册和生成产物，不能只手工改 JSON 外形。

### 后端错误消息

后端 `message_key` 使用以下格式：

```text
<package 去掉版本>.<Service 业务路径>.<操作或对象>.<字段>.<规则>
```

Proto package 去掉版本号，Service 去掉 `Service` 后按 PascalCase 拆成小写点号路径：

```text
system.admin.v1 + BaseDictService -> system.admin.base.dict
system.admin.v1 + CodeGenTableService -> system.admin.code.gen.table
base.v1 + LoginService -> base.login
```

示例：

```text
system.admin.base.dict.entity.name.required
system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
system.admin.base.dict.update.id.required
system.admin.code.gen.table.field.page_type.required
```

`entity` 表示实体本身的校验，其他值表示具体操作。字段名和规则名使用 Proto 风格的 `snake_case`。规则名称应保持稳定，优先使用 `required`、`max_length`、`min_length`、`format`、`pattern`、`positive`、`non_negative`、`unique`、`supported` 等固定词汇。

通用错误不绑定具体 Service：

```text
common.error.invalid_argument
common.error.permission_denied
```

版本号 `v1` 不进入 key；`message_key` 会随错误响应返回，是对外稳定契约，重命名必须同步 Proto、Go、全部语言目录和调用方。

### 前后端对应关系

前后端不要求使用完全相同的 key，但业务路径应能相互对应：

```text
前端：system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
后端：system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
```

动态菜单、字典、配置等数据库翻译使用 `base_i18n` 的目标类型和编号，不复用固定文案 key。

## 动态资源翻译

动态资源共用一张翻译表 `base_i18n`，通过 `target_type` 区分目标资源：

| `target_type` | 主表 | 可翻译字段 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `1` | `base_config` | 文本和富文本配置值 |
| `2` | `base_config` | 系统配置名称 |
| `3` | `base_dict` | 字典名称 |
| `4` | `base_dict_item` | 字典项标签 |
| `5` | `base_menu` | 菜单标题 |

`base_dict.code` 和 `base_dict_item.value` 是稳定的业务标识，不进入翻译表；字典名称和字典项标签分别对应 `3` 和 `4`，系统配置名称与值分别对应 `2` 和 `1`。

创建或更新动态资源时，主语言文本写入主表；手动输入的非主语言文本直接写入 `base_i18n`。未输入的语言由翻译任务补充，已有非空翻译不会被覆盖；主语言不在翻译表重复保存，缺失时回退主表。

内置菜单、字典、字典项和系统配置的固定译文位于同版本 `i18n.<locale>.up.sql`。迁移使用幂等的 `INSERT IGNORE`，不会覆盖已经维护的数据；已执行版本不能通过重写文件修复，必须增加新版本迁移。

## 机器翻译

服务运行时的机器翻译通过 `kratos-kit/translator` 按 `backend/configs/translator.yaml` 选择 Provider，入口包括：

- 管理端 `BaseI18nService.DraftBaseI18n`：针对已保存的菜单、字典、字典项或配置生成并保存单条译文。
- 菜单、字典、字典项和配置创建或更新成功后：先投递资源消息到异步翻译队列；队列消费失败时由定时任务扫描待处理译文兜底。
- 管理端编辑器提交空文本，或列表名称悬停时发现空缺译文，会按同一接口即时补齐；人工填写的非空译文保持不变。

批量语言包和迁移译文由 `make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=<locale>` 调用独立脚本生成，不属于正常服务请求链路。

翻译接口默认关闭，通过 `translator.enabled=true`、`I18N_DRAFT_ENABLED=true` 或应用 metadata 开启。服务端读取受控源文本，目标语言限定为已启用语言，串行调用并使用 `translator.timeout` 配置的 HTTP 超时（默认 8 秒）；已有非空翻译不会被覆盖。系统配置名称以及文本、富文本类型的值会进入机器翻译，图片和布尔值不会外发。

Provider 只用于翻译，不能用于登录、错误响应、普通 CRUD 或任意文本翻译代理。Provider 不可用时，固定语言包、已有翻译和主语言回退仍必须正常工作。

## 代码生成

代码生成器使用 `backend/internal/biz/system/admin/codegen/locales/catalog.json` 的固定模板，并从表级、字段级 `i18n_config` 读取业务名称和字段名称。生成页面会写入所有编译期语言的稳定 key；非主语言缺少必要配置时，正式生成前应先补齐并在预览中显示缺失项。

生成器不得把新的中文 UI 文案直接写入 Vue、Proto 或菜单 SQL。生成结果属于当前代码生成对象的 key 范围，不能覆盖其他模块或人工维护的翻译。

## 数据库迁移

新语言或新译文使用更高版本目录：

```text
backend/migration/assets/vX.Y.Z/mysql/
├── language.up.sql
├── language.description.md
├── i18n.<locale>.up.sql
└── i18n.<locale>.description.md
```

`make i18n-sync I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=vX.Y.Z` 生成 `base_language` 初始化记录；`make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=<locale>` 默认将动态翻译 SQL 写入当前 `v0.0.1`，如需新版本目录再传入 `I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=vX.Y.Z`。生成后应检查 SQL 和语言包，再提交同一版本的描述文件；已人工完成的语言包不要用批量脚本覆盖。

`base_language` 的启用状态、排序和主语言是部署配置，不应通过重新执行语言包同步脚本强行覆盖。生产环境不能修改已执行的迁移文件。

## 验证清单

新增或修改语言后至少检查：

1. `make i18n-check` 和 `make i18n-sync` 通过。
2. 管理端、uni-app、Taro 的 key 和占位符校验通过。
3. 语言接口失败时，三端仍能使用编译期回退列表。
4. 登录前、登录后、刷新和重新打开应用都能恢复语言选择。
5. 菜单、字典和配置在有非空译文、缺失译文和主语言切换时都能正确回退。
6. 校验、认证、权限和资源错误的 reason 不变，只本地化 message。
7. `go test ./...` 及受影响 workspace 的类型检查、lint 通过。

新增语言的逐步命令、文件清单和故障排查见[国际化语言扩展指南](国际化语言扩展指南.md)。

documents.content:
# 国际化语言扩展指南

本文是新增语言的执行手册。当前固定语言集合为 `zh-CN`、`zh-TW`、`en-US`、`ja-JP`。新增语言时，编译期语言包决定“代码能渲染什么语言”，`base_language` 数据只决定“当前部署启用什么语言、如何排序以及哪种语言是动态资源主语言”。

## 先理解两层职责

| 层 | 权威来源 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 编译期 | 后端错误目录、三端 core/System JSON、代码生成目录 | 语言白名单、固定 UI 文案、错误文案、代码生成模板 |
| 运行期 | `base_language` 表 | 语言名称、原生名称、启用状态、排序、主语言 |

因此只在数据库增加一条语言记录不能让页面出现新语言；只增加前端 JSON 也不能让动态菜单、字典和登录页读取到该语言。两层必须同步。

## 需要增加的文件

每个语言代码都必须在以下七个语言包目录使用同名 JSON 文件；代码生成器另有一个统一的 `catalog.json`：

| 目录 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `backend/internal/i18n/assets` | 后端错误消息目录 |
| `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales` | 管理端底座和公共文案 |
| `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales` | 管理端 System 文案 |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales` | uni-app 底座和公共文案 |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales` | uni-app System 文案 |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales` | Taro 底座和公共文案 |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales` | Taro System 文案 |
`backend/internal/biz/system/admin/codegen/locales/catalog.json` 不是语言包目录，而是按语言代码组织的代码生成器模板和静态术语数据。

JSON 的 key、占位符和命名空间必须保持不变。`common.language.<locale>` 用于离线显示语言名称，可以补充；运行时名称优先从数据库读取，因此新增语言不需要修改已有语言包或 TypeScript 注册代码。

## Key 命名速查

新增固定文案时，先确定所属模块和组件，再按统一规则命名：

```text
前端：<模块>.<defineOptions.name 转换路径>.<文案类型>.<名称>
后端：<package 去掉版本>.<Service 转换路径>.<操作或对象>.<字段>.<规则>
```

示例：

```text
BaseDict -> system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
BaseDictService / system.admin.v1 -> system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
CodeGenTable -> system.code.gen.table.field.page_type
```

组件名和 Service 名按 PascalCase 拆成小写点号路径；末端名称、字段和规则统一使用 `snake_case`。跨业务公共文案使用 `common.*`，后端通用错误使用 `common.error.*`。后端 key 不带 `v1`；`message_key` 改名需要同步 Proto、Go 和全部语言目录。

## 标准流程

### 1. 选择语言代码

使用 BCP 47 形式，例如 `de-DE`、`pt-BR`。语言代码必须在全部目录一致，不能同时出现 `de`、`de-DE` 两种表示。代码需要能被 Core 的 `resource/i18n` 语言资源目录解析，并且管理端的 Day.js、Element Plus locale 依赖能找到对应区域或基础语言映射。

### 2. 增加语言包

以 `zh-CN.json` 为 key 基准，在上表七个目录增加 `<locale>.json`，逐项翻译 value：

```text
backend/internal/i18n/assets/de-DE.json
frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
```

代码生成器的 `catalog.json` 不是按文件拆分，而是在同一个 JSON 对象中增加 `"de-DE"`，字段必须完整保留：`menu`、`resource`、`password_strength`、`static`。

`common.language.<locale>` 可写入管理端 Core 语言包，用于离线显示语言名称和生成 `base_language` 迁移的初始名称；运行时语言名称、排序和启用状态仍以数据库记录为准。新增语言不需要修改已有语言包中的语言名称键。

翻译时必须保留 `{name}`、`{field}`、`{max}`、`{{.Value}}` 等占位符以及 URL、权限路径、字典 code/value 和 HTML/Markdown 标签。不要翻译路由 `name`、`path`、`component` 或 API 路径。

### 3. 运行同步脚本

在仓库根目录执行：

```bash
make i18n-sync
```

脚本会检查：

- 七个语言包目录的文件集合是否一致；
- 每个语言包的 key 集合和占位符是否一致；
- 代码生成器语言目录字段是否完整；
- 管理端 Day.js 和 Element Plus 是否存在可用映射。

检查通过后脚本生成以下文件，不要手工编辑：

- 六个前端包的 `src/locales/generated.ts`；
- 管理端 Day.js、Element Plus locale 映射；
- 传入迁移版本时生成 `language.up.sql` 和说明文件。

### 4. 生成数据库语言记录

当前仓库统一使用 `v0.0.1` 迁移；生成语言初始化记录时写入该版本：

```bash
make i18n-sync I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=v0.0.1
```

脚本生成的迁移只负责补充 `base_language` 记录，使用 `INSERT IGNORE`，不会覆盖已有部署的启用状态、排序和主语言配置。提交前检查迁移版本目录，确保 `language.up.sql` 与说明文件一起提交。

如果部署不希望立即启用语言，可以在迁移后将 `base_language.status` 调整为禁用；主语言只能通过管理端语言配置或数据库配置切换，不能通过前端语言包改变。

### 5. 准备动态资源译文（可选）

固定 UI 和后端错误包完整后，新语言即可在运行时回退主语言。若要为内置菜单、字典、字典项和系统配置提供固定译文，可以使用批量脚本生成语言包和动态翻译数据：

```bash
I18N_OFFLINE=1 \
make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=de-DE
```

联网翻译可去掉 `I18N_OFFLINE=1`。该命令默认写入 `v0.0.1` 下的对应语言包、`i18n.de-DE.up.sql` 及说明文件。迁移只写入非空固定文本，已有值不会覆盖；若语言包已经人工完成，直接维护 `i18n.<locale>.up.sql`，不要用该命令覆盖人工译文。

动态资源也可以在管理端国际化维护页面中编辑。表单中有内容的主语言文本可单独或批量即时翻译，Draft 接口只返回单个译文、不写入统一国际化表；人工输入会直接保存到统一国际化表。空译文在资源创建或更新成功后进入异步国际化队列，提交空文本时也会按保存逻辑补齐，失败消息由定时任务再次扫描，已有非空译文不会覆盖。国际化接口只有在 `I18N_DRAFT_ENABLED=true` 或等价应用 metadata 开启时可用。系统配置名称以及文本、富文本类型的值支持国际化，图片和布尔值不外发；运行时值缺失时回退主语言。

### 6. 验证并提交

推荐在提交前执行：

```bash
make i18n-check
make i18n-sync
git diff --check

cd backend && go test ./...
cd ../frontend/admin && pnpm type:check && pnpm lint:oxlint
cd ../uni-app && pnpm tsc && pnpm lint
cd ../taro-app && pnpm tsc && pnpm lint
```

确认新增语言在以下场景可用：首次启动、登录前语言切换、登录后切换、刷新恢复、动态菜单、字典展示、校验错误和缺少动态译文时的主语言回退。

## 不需要修改的内容

新增语言不需要修改：

- Go locale 常量、后端服务注册和错误本地化代码；
- 三端 locale runtime、模块注册和请求封装；
- Proto、RPC 生成文件和菜单路由代码。

这些运行时文件读取编译期语言包和同步脚本生成的前端注册文件；运行时启用语言、默认语言和排序由 `base_language` 数据库记录提供。只有在新增语言暴露出基础库没有 locale 映射、语言包结构需要新增字段或业务确实增加新翻译 key 时，才需要相应依赖或代码变更。

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 检查 |
| --- | --- |
| `语言集合不一致` | 七个语言包目录是否都存在同名 JSON |
| `语言键集合不一致` | 与同目录 `zh-CN.json` 比较 key 和占位符 |
| `代码生成器语言目录字段不完整` | `catalog.json` 是否包含四个固定字段及完整子字段 |
| `缺少组件语言映射` | Day.js/Element Plus 是否提供该区域或基础语言文件 |
| 语言能切换但名称为空 | 检查 `base_language` 记录，或补充 `common.language.<locale>` |
| 菜单/字典仍显示主语言 | 检查统一翻译表是否存在非空记录，以及请求是否发送 `Accept-Language` |

完整架构说明见[国际化最终方案](国际化最终方案.md)；语言包目录的局部约束见各目录 README。

documents.content:
# Interface parameter verification

The backend uses `buf.validate` to declare rules, and `backend/internal/server/middleware/validate.go` to call protovalidate in HTTP and gRPC business processing. When verification fails, `INVALID_ARGUMENT` is returned, and the response boundary is localized to `message` of the first violation according to the request language; the error reason and metadata remain stable.

The `rules` of the management side `ProForm` is used for real-time interactive prompts and cannot replace server-side verification; constraints at both ends should express the same business rules.

## Proto writing method

```proto
import "buf/validate/validate.proto";
import "gnostic/openapi/v3/annotations.proto";

message ExampleForm {
  string name = 1 [
    (gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "名称"},
    (buf.validate.field).cel = {
      id: "example.name.required"
      message: "请输入名称"
      expression: "this.size() > 0"
    },
    (buf.validate.field).cel = {
      id: "example.name.max_len"
      message: "名称不能超过 30 个字符"
      expression: "this.size() <= 30"
    }
  ]; // 名称
}

message CreateExampleRequest {
  ExampleForm example = 1 [
    (gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "示例表单"},
    (buf.validate.field).required = true
  ]; // 示例表单
}
```

The rule ID uses the stable `<resource>.<field>.<rule>`, and Chinese messages are directed to users. Don't rely on the generator's default English errors.

## Common rules

| Constraints | Proto |
| --- | --- |
| String required | CEL `this.size() > 0` |
| Maximum length | CEL `this.size() <= 30` |
| Positive ID | CEL `this > 0` |
| Required for nested messages | `(buf.validate.field).required = true` |
| Enumeration is legal | `(buf.validate.field).enum = {defined_only: true}` |
| The list is not empty | CEL `this.size() > 0` |
| Unique list | CEL `this.unique()` |
| Email | `(buf.validate.field).string.email = true` |
| URL | `(buf.validate.field).string.uri = true` |
| Regular | `(buf.validate.field).string.pattern = "..."` |
| Value collection | `(buf.validate.field).string.in = ["a", "b"]` |

Cross-field rules are written at the message level:

```proto
message PeriodForm {
  option (buf.validate.message).cel = {
    id: "period.range"
    message: "结束时间不能早于开始时间"
    expression: "this.end_at >= this.start_at"
  };

  int64 start_at = 1 [(gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "开始时间"}]; // 开始时间
  int64 end_at = 2 [(gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "结束时间"}]; // 结束时间
}
```

Uniqueness, foreign key existence, tenant permissions, protected resources and state transfer depend on the database or current identity, must be placed in biz, and cannot be disguised as format verification.

## ProForm corresponding

```ts
const fields: ProFormField[] = [
  {
    prop: "name",
    label: "名称",
    component: "input",
    props: { maxlength: 30, showWordLimit: true },
    rules: [
      { required: true, message: "请输入名称", trigger: "blur" },
      { max: 30, message: "名称不能超过 30 个字符", trigger: "blur" }
    ]
  }
];
```

- `required`, length, range, format and number of lists are provided on the front end.
- `maxlength`, `min`, `max` and other control restrictions should be consistent with rules and Proto.
- The business verification message returned by the backend is still the final result, and the frontend must not skip error processing just because it passes the form verification.
- `optional` Format rules are only executed when the field has a value; non-required fields on the front end should not add `required` unconditionally.

## Change check

1. Modify Proto annotation, OpenAPI description and `buf.validate`.
2. Execute `make -C backend api` and `make i18n-openapi`.
3. Execute `make -C backend ts-admin`, `make -C backend ts-uni-app` or `make -C backend ts-taro-app` according to the consumer side; execute `make -C backend ts` when three terminals need to be generated at one time.
4. Synchronize ProForm rules, control restrictions and interface error display.
5. Execute back-end testing and corresponding front-end type checking.

generates Go, OpenAPI, and TypeScript RPCs without manual modification.

documents.content:
# 数据库与初始化数据

## 当前数据源

系统默认使用 MySQL 数据库 `kratos_admin`，配置位于 `backend/configs/data.yaml` 和 `data_local.yaml`。Redis 用于验证码、一次性密码密钥、Token 等缓存状态。

`data.database` 表示单一默认数据源；`data.databases` 可声明多个命名数据源。默认数据源保存系统表以及所有模块的 `base_migration` 执行记录。

## 建表和迁移

启动顺序为：

1. 创建全部 GORM 客户端。
2. 对 `enable_migrate: true` 的客户端执行注册模型的 `AutoMigrate`。
3. 加载模块迁移资源，按依赖、版本、数据库类型和数据源执行 `.up.sql`。
4. 完成 OpenAPI 接口数据、租户角色菜单和 Casbin 策略同步。

`enable_migrate` 只控制 GORM 自动建表，不会关闭版本化 SQL。全新环境应为默认数据源启用它，否则 `base_migration` 等表可能尚不存在。

## 资源结构

当前内置资源：

```text
backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql/
├── base_area.up.sql
├── default_data.up.sql
├── default_data.description.md
├── i18n.en-US.up.sql
├── i18n.zh-TW.up.sql
└── i18n.ja-JP.up.sql
```

目录规则：

```text
assets/<version>/<database-type>/<feature>.up.sql
assets/<version>/<database-type>/<feature>.down.sql          # 可选
assets/<version>/<database-type>/<feature>.description.md
assets/<version>/<database-type>/<data-source>/<feature>.up.sql
```

当前仓库内置并验证的是 `mysql`。数据库类型目录下的直系文件属于 `default` 数据源；一级子目录是命名数据源，必须与配置名称一致。需要接入其他数据库类型时，必须先确认对应驱动、模型迁移和 SQL 方言，再新增迁移目录。脚本和描述按文件名排序读取。

迁移记录唯一标识包含模块、数据源和版本。一个版本内任一升级脚本失败会回滚该版本并阻止服务启动，修复后重启会重试未记录版本。

## 初始化内容

`default_data.up.sql` 提供：

- 默认租户、部门、岗位、角色和 `super`、`admin` 开发账号。
- 系统配置、字典、菜单、按钮和服务方法权限关系。
- 管理端 System 页面、AI、代码生成、API 文档和应用端所需权限入口。

`default_data.up.sql` 负责语言记录、默认业务数据、菜单和权限；同版本 `i18n.{locale}.up.sql` 通过 `base_i18n.target_type` 提供菜单、字典、字典项和系统配置名称/值的非主语言译文。五类翻译数据按单条 `INSERT IGNORE` 写入。主语言由 `base_language.is_primary` 配置，主表保存主语言文本，其他启用语言保存到统一翻译表。翻译表及代码生成 `i18n_config` 字段由 GORM `AutoMigrate` 创建。

`base_area.up.sql` 提供地区基础数据。初始化 SQL 使用 `INSERT IGNORE`，遇到已有唯一键记录时跳过，不覆盖已有数据。

启动时 `BaseApiCase.InitializeOpenAPI` 根据已注册 OpenAPI 重建接口元数据，随后同步租户管理员菜单并重建 Casbin 规则。因此修改 Proto 路径或菜单 API 列表时，必须同时重新生成 OpenAPI 并更新版本化 SQL。

## 新环境

```sql
CREATE DATABASE kratos_admin CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
```

启动后端后，默认开发账号为：

- `super / 112233`
- `admin / 112233`

这些凭据只用于本地初始化，部署前必须修改。

## 存量升级

- 不修改已经发布并执行的版本目录，新增更高版本。
- 结构变更、数据修复、菜单和权限调整放在同一功能版本中。
- 新增语言先按[国际化语言扩展指南](国际化语言扩展指南.md)生成语言包和 `language.up.sql`；动态固定译文另生成 `i18n.<locale>.up.sql`。
- SQL 保持幂等，避免 `TRUNCATE`、无条件全表更新或删除。
- 生产执行前备份并验证回滚策略；需要回退时显式提供 `.down.sql`。

documents.content:
# Service access guide

This article explains how to integrate a new capability into the current Backend, Management or Application. Only describe the expansion methods that the warehouse has adopted.

## Determine ownership first

| Scenario | Backend Proto | Backend Implementation | Frontend |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shared by admin, uni-app and Taro | `api/proto/base/v1` | `biz/base`, `service/base/v1` | Three terminals generated and packaged on demand |
| System Administration | `api/proto/system/admin/v1` | `biz/system/admin`, `service/system/admin/v1` | System Module |
| Application system capabilities | `api/proto/system/app/v1` | `biz/system/app`, `service/system/app/v1` | uni-app and Taro |
| Independent business module | Module’s own Proto | Module’s own implementation | Independent management terminal, uni-app or Taro host module |

general types preferentially reuse `common.v1` in Buf; System cross-end enumeration puts `system/common/v1`.

## Built-in backend capabilities

1. When the table structure changes, update the development library first, and then run `make -C backend gorm-gen`.
2. Define Proto, HTTP mapping, OpenAPI description, and `buf.validate`.
3. Run `make -C backend api` and `make i18n-openapi`, according to the consumer side, run `make -C backend ts-admin`, `make -C backend ts-uni-app` or `make -C backend ts-taro-app`; run when three terminals need to be generated at one time `make -C backend ts`.
4. Implement the business in the corresponding `internal/biz/<proto-directory>`, and implement the Proto service in `internal/service/<proto-directory>`.
5. Add the service to the corresponding `internal/server/{base/v1,system/admin/v1,system/app/v1}/register.go`.
6. Update `backend/wire.go` after the ProviderSet or construction parameters change and run `make -C backend wire`.
7. Add default data, menu, button and service method permissions in the new migrated version.
8. If user-visible copy is added, synchronize the language package of the corresponding module and execute `make i18n-sync`.

The generated directories are `api/gen/go`, `internal/data/gen`, `internal/openapi/assets/openapi.yaml`, `src/rpc` and `wire_gen.go` for the management side, uni-app and Taro packages, and must not be edited manually.

service only does parameter passing, logging and error reporting; transactions, tenants, permissions and status rules are placed in biz; Repository uses the generated typed Query and does not splice runtime SQL.

## External Go module

The external module provides static resources that must be collected before building the business through `module.Resources`:

```go
func NewModuleResources() module.Resources {
	return module.Resources{
		ProjectKey:  "order",
		ProjectName: "订单",
		Models:      orderdata.Models(),
		OpenAPI:     orderopenapi.Assets(),
		Docs:        orderdocs.Assets(),
		Migrations: []module.Migration{{Name: "order", FS: ordermigration.Assets(), Path: "."}},
		I18n:        orderi18n.Assets(),
	}
}
```

Core will first initialize infrastructure such as databases, caches, and queues based on static resources. Then Wire builds modules Case and Service, and the complete module implements protocol registration and runtime contribution:

```go
type Module struct {
	service orderv1.OrderServiceHTTPServer
}

func (m *Module) RegisterHTTP(server *http.Server) {
	orderv1.RegisterOrderServiceHTTPServer(server, m.service)
}

func (m *Module) registerAI(registrar module.AIRegistrar) error {
	return registrar.RegisterTools(module.AITerminalAdmin, m.agentTools...)
}

func (m *Module) Contributions() module.Contributions {
	return module.Contributions{
		AI: m.registerAI,
		/* Tasks、SSE、StartupHooks */
	}
}
```

composition root uses `kratoscore.ProviderSet`, `kratoscore.BusinessProviderSet`, `NewModuleResources` and the module business Provider; Core is exposed through The `biz`, `biz/dto`, `config`, `module` types provide BaseCase, Job, SSE, OpenAPI and Docs capabilities, and the `internal` directory only retains Core implementation details.

Inter-module calls only use generated gRPC Clients. `Runtime.ClientConn()` is available in the process, the remote uses standard gRPC connection, and the calling code does not depend on Backend `internal`.

## Database and permissions

Migration directory:

```text
backend/migration/assets/vX.Y.Z/mysql/<feature>.up.sql
backend/migration/assets/vX.Y.Z/mysql/<feature>.description.md
backend/migration/assets/vX.Y.Z/mysql/<data-source>/<feature>.up.sql
```

The management menu `component` must use the complete module prefix, for example, the System page is `system/base/user/index`. Menu `api` saves the Proto service method identifier, such as `/system.admin.v1.BaseUserService/PageBaseUser`; the HTTP path is synchronized to `base_api` by OpenAPI. These two concepts cannot be mixed.

## Management module

The current default business module is `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-system`:

```text
frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src
├── api
├── rpc
├── views
├── module.ts
└── index.ts
```

pages are isolated by module name prefix:

```ts
const views = import.meta.glob<{ default: Component }>("./views/**/*.vue");

export const orderAdminModule = defineAdminModule({
  name: "order",
  views
});
```

`views/list/index.vue` corresponds to the menu component `order/list/index`. Modules can also declare `staticViews`, `headerTools`, `userMenuActions`, `routeOptions`, and name `extensions`.

The host maintains package names, loaders, and optional pre-built dependencies only in `apps/admin/src/module-manifest.ts`. When adding a module, the host `package.json` dependency is added simultaneously. Modules must not use core's private `@/*` path and may only reference the `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core` public subpath.

Create an independent business workspace in this warehouse:

```bash
cd frontend/admin
pnpm module:create ../../../order-admin --module order
```

## Application host

The application-side page is placed in `src/views` of the package it belongs to, and the physical page and stable view key are declared through the module's `pages` and `views`. The request is placed in `src/api` of the package it belongs to. The business type comes from the generated `src/rpc`. The page does not directly call `uni.request`.

External hosts can use:

```ts
const result = bootstrapKratosApp({
  app: App,
  pinia,
  modules: [{
    name: "order",
    pages: { "pagesOrder/list/index": {} },
    views: { ORDER_LIST: "pagesOrder/list/index" }
  }]
});
```

`KratosAppModule` describes the module page using `pages`, `views`, and optionally `icons`. The `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-core/vite` of the release package exposes `kratosApp()` and `createKratosUniPlugin()`; the external host passes the same module list in the Vite configuration to reuse page scanning, wrapper generation, static resource merging and post-build recovery capabilities.

The access example of this warehouse is located at `frontend/uni-app/apps/uni-app/vite.config.ts`. The same path page is subject to the host configuration. The later registration module can overwrite the first registration module.

The Taro host uses `defineKratosTaroModule()` and `defineKratosTaroBuildModule()` to declare runtime, page and build-time entries simultaneously. The configuration example is located at `frontend/taro-app/apps/taro-app/src/module-manifest.ts`. Module pages are assembled by `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-core/runner` during build, the host does not commit the generated wrapper or page configuration.

## Verify

```bash
make i18n-check
cd backend && go test ./...
pnpm --dir frontend/admin check:exports
pnpm --dir frontend/admin lint:oxlint
pnpm --dir frontend/admin type:check
pnpm --dir frontend/uni-app test
pnpm --dir frontend/uni-app lint
pnpm --dir frontend/uni-app tsc
pnpm --dir frontend/taro-app test
pnpm --dir frontend/taro-app lint
pnpm --dir frontend/taro-app tsc
```

During joint debugging, check the dynamic menu, button permissions, tenant data range, `/api/docs/openapi/{key}`, SSE/MCP, and the behavior of new migrations on empty databases and migrated databases.

# Login and password encryption

This article records the account password, verification code, OAuth, password ciphertext and Token mechanism currently shared by the management end, uni-app and Taro. The interface is based on `backend/api/proto/base/v1/login.proto`, `oauth.proto`.

## Log in with account and password

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant UI as 前端
  participant API as Backend
  participant Cache as Redis
  UI->>API: GET /api/v1/base/config
  UI->>API: GET /api/v1/base/captcha
  UI->>API: POST /api/v1/base/captcha/verify（行为验证码）
  UI->>API: GET /api/v1/base/password-public-key?scene=LOGIN
  API->>Cache: 保存一次性私钥，TTL 5 分钟
  UI->>UI: RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM 加密密码
  UI->>API: POST /api/v1/base/session
  API->>Cache: 消费验证码和一次性私钥
  API-->>UI: access_token / refresh_token / expires_in
  UI->>API: GET 当前端 profile
```

When the tenant code is not passed, the backend uses the default tenant. The account is queried by `tenant_code + user_name`; there is currently no branch logged in by the independent `phone` field.

Ordinary verification code submits `captcha_id` and the user's answer directly. Verification codes for behaviors such as sliders, clicks, and rotations first call `/api/v1/base/captcha/verify` to obtain a one-time `captcha_token` valid for 2 minutes, and then submit the token as the login `captcha_code`.

## Password protocol

algorithm identification:

```text
RSA-OAEP-256+A256GCM
```

1. The front end requests the one-time RSA public key of the specified scenario.
2. The front end performs `trim()` on the password, generating a 32-byte AES-256 key and a 12-byte GCM IV.
3. AES-GCM encryption password, RSA-OAEP(SHA-256) encryption AES key.
4. Submit `key_id`, `nonce`, `algorithm`, `encrypted_key`, `iv`, `ciphertext` after Base64 encoding.
5. Backend verification scenario, nonce and algorithm, read and immediately delete the private key from Redis, decrypt it and compare the database password hash with `go-utils/crypto.Verify`.

One-time key has a TTL of 5 minutes and is deleted once read. The same ciphertext cannot be replayed; if a retry fails, the public key must be retrieved and encrypted again.

H5 on the management side and both application sides uses Web Crypto. uni-app and Taro WeChat mini programs use `asmcrypto.js`, `wx.getRandomValues` and WeChat Base64 API statically introduced by their respective bases to avoid dynamic import compatibility issues in the mini program environment.

## WeChat Mini Program OAuth

Application side `MP-WEIXIN` uses provider `wechatmini`:

1. `wx.login()` Get code and submit `/api/v1/base/oauth/session`.
2. Return Token directly when it is bound or automatic registration is allowed.
3. When not bound, `binding_required=true` is returned, and the page displays the tenant, user name, password and verification code.
4. Call `wx.login()` again before binding submission, and then request `/api/v1/base/oauth/binding/session`.

WeChat code can only be used once, and the same code cannot be reused for detection of binding status and formal binding.

The management side also supports OAuth provider list, authorization jump, callback, binding list and unbinding; the specific provider is configured by `backend/configs/oauth*.yaml`.

## Token

login response contains `token_type`, `access_token`, `refresh_token`, and `expires_in`. The front end saves `Bearer <access_token>`, refresh token and the converted absolute expiration time.

The application request layer calls `POST /api/v1/base/token` when the access token remains no more than 5 minutes, and concurrent refreshes share the same Promise. The backend issues a new access token and retains the original refresh token. If the refresh fails, the local login status will be cleared; logging out will delete the access/refresh token and the cached authentication information corresponding to the refresh token.

Public authentication requests use `authMode: "none"` or equivalent configuration, and do not carry the old `Authorization`; requests that require login automatically add Token.

## Key entry

| realm | path |
| --- | --- |
| Login Proto | `backend/api/proto/base/v1/login.proto` |
| OAuth Proto | `backend/api/proto/base/v1/oauth.proto` |
| Backend login | `backend/internal/biz/base/login.go` |
| Backend OAuth | `backend/internal/biz/base/oauth.go` |
| Key generation and decryption | `backend/internal/biz/base/utils/password_crypto.go` |
| Management side password encryption | `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/utils/passwordCrypto.ts` |
| uni-app login and password encryption | `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/views/pages/login/login.vue`, `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/utils/passwordCrypto.ts` |
| Taro login and password encryption | `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/views/pages/login/login.tsx`, `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/utils/passwordCrypto.ts` |
| Application-side Token and request | Each of the two application-side `packages/core/src/utils/auth.ts`, `http.ts` |

When troubleshooting login failure, check the configuration, verification code, public key, ciphertext scenario, login response, token saving and profile request in sequence. Do not record clear text passwords, private keys, full tokens, or verification code answers in logs or documents.

# Overall system design

This article only describes the modules, running relationships and expansion boundaries that already exist in the current warehouse. See [docs/README](README.md) for the document entry. The specific commands are subject to the README and Makefile of each module.

## module

| Module | Responsibilities | Products |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` | Kratos HTTP/gRPC service, authentication authority, system business, AI, tasks, migration and static hosting. | Go services, OpenAPI |
| `kratos-core` | Reusable Kratos host runtime without business proto. | Standalone Go module |
| `frontend/admin/packages/core` | Management side startup, login, dynamic routing, layout, status and public components. | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core` |
| `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system` | System management, personal center, AI and development tool pages. | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-system` |
| `frontend/admin/packages/cli` | Create business management end workspace. | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-cli` |
| `frontend/admin/apps/admin` | The default management host that combines core and System. | Private package `@liujitcn/kratos-admin`, `backend/data/admin` |
| `frontend/uni-app` | Home, Login, My, Profile, Settings, WebView and AI uni-app application. | `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app`, `backend/data/app` |
| `frontend/taro-app` | A React/Taro application that shares the backend contract with uni-app and supports H5 and WeChat applets. | `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app`, `backend/data/app` |
| `backend/migration` | Versioned database and initialization data. | Embedded SQL |

The warehouse currently does not have business modules such as shopping mall, order, payment, recommendation, etc.

## Running relationship

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Admin["管理端宿主"] -->|"/api /events"| Backend["Backend"]
  UniApp["uni-app"] -->|"/api"| Backend
  Taro["Taro app"] -->|"/api"| Backend
  Backend --> DB[("MySQL")]
  Backend --> Redis[("Redis")]
  Backend -->|"/admin/"| AdminFiles["data/admin"]
  Backend -->|"/app/"| AppFiles["data/app"]
  Module["外部 core.Module"] --> Backend
```

Backend can run independently or can be connected to other Core hosts through `kratosadmin.NewModule`. The two forms reuse the same Service, biz and Repository; in-process calls use `Runtime.ClientConn()`, and remote calls use standard gRPC connections.

## Backend layering

```text
api/proto
  -> api/gen/go
  -> internal/service/{base/v1,system/admin/v1,system/app/v1}
  -> internal/biz/{base,system/admin,system/app,...}
  -> internal/data/gen
```

- Proto is the only contract source for HTTP, gRPC, checksum frontend types.
- service only does transmission adaptation and error reporting, business rules are placed in biz, and database access is limited to data.
- `internal/server/{base/v1,system/admin/v1,system/app/v1}` registers the transmission service; `internal/module` is responsible for the module adaptation from Admin to Core and the Wire combination root. The root directory `wire.go` only provides a public assembly facade, and `internal/cmd` is responsible for the process startup entrance.
- Cross-module data access only using generated clients, does not expose internal Model, Query, Repository or Case.

Core's `Module` is responsible for gRPC, HTTP, MCP registration; optional Contributor can provide middleware, background server, OpenAPI, tasks, queue consumers, SSE, startup scripts, startup hooks, health checks and static resources.

## Front-end boundary

The management side dependency direction is fixed to:

```text
apps/admin -> packages/modules/system -> packages/core
```

Business modules provide module-prefixed pages, static page replacements, top tools, user menus, routing options, and named extensions via `AdminModule`. The default host's module list is maintained only in `apps/admin/src/module-manifest.ts`.

The application side is an independent pnpm workspace, and the dependency direction is fixed as:

```text
apps/uni-app -> packages/modules/system -> packages/core
```

`KratosAppModule` declares pages, stable view keys, and static icons via `pages`, `views`, and `icons`. The host only maintains `apps/uni-app/src/module-manifest.ts`, and the Vite plug-in exposed by core scans the module page and merges `pages.json` and static resources during the build period.

The Taro application uses an independent React/Taro workspace, and the dependency direction is:

```text
apps/taro-app -> packages/modules/* -> packages/ui -> packages/core
```

`defineKratosTaroModule()` declares the runtime module, `defineKratosTaroBuildModule()` provides a build-time page description; the runner of `packages/core` generates page wrappers, subcontracting configurations and static resources during development or build, and the host only submits fixed bootstrap pages.

## Contract and generation

| Command | Output |
| --- | --- |
| `make -C backend api` | `backend/api/gen/go` |
| `make i18n-openapi` | `backend/internal/openapi/assets/openapi.yaml`, `openapi.en-US.yaml`, `openapi.zh-TW.yaml`, `openapi.ja-JP.yaml` |
| `make -C backend ts-admin` | `src/rpc` of management core and system |
| `make -C backend ts-uni-app` | `src/rpc` of uni-app core and system packages |
| `make -C backend ts-taro-app` | `src/rpc` of Taro core and system packages |
| `make -C backend ts` | Generate management, uni-app and Taro all at once `src/rpc` |
| `make -C backend gorm-gen` | `backend/internal/data/gen` |
| `make -C backend wire` | `backend/wire_gen.go` |

The interface change is completed by "Proto → Generate → service/biz → Front-end request and page → Migrate permissions". The generated files do not need to be modified manually.

## Data and permissions

Migration resources are organized by `assets/<version>/<database-type>/<data-source?>`. The default MySQL resource is located at `backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql`. At startup, GORM automatically builds tables according to configuration, then executes versioned SQL, and finally synchronizes `base_api`, tenant role menu and Casbin policy from OpenAPI and menu relationships.

uses JWT access/refresh token for authentication; password transmission uses one-time RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM hybrid encryption; tenant and permissions are determined by the server.

## Document index

| Topics | Documentation |
| --- | --- |
| Backend and Core | [backend README](../backend/README.md), standalone `kratos-core` repository |
| Management | [frontend/admin README](../frontend/admin/README.md) |
| Application | [frontend/uni-app README](../frontend/uni-app/README.md) |
| Taro application | [frontend/taro-app README](../frontend/taro-app/README.md) |
| New capability access | [Service access guide](服务接入指南.md) |
| Database | [Database and initialization data design](数据库与初始化数据设计.md) |
| Interface verification | [Interface parameter verification design](接口参数校验设计.md) |
| Login | [Login and password encryption process](登录与密码加密流程.md) |
| AI | [AI assistant design](AI助手设计.md) |
| Management-side components | [Front-end component list](前端组件清单.md) |
| International Design | [Final Internationalization Plan](国际化最终方案.md) |
| New languages | [International Language Extension Guide](国际化语言扩展指南.md) |
